The W52 wave was split into three sequential waves (W59 additive schema, W60 consumer migration with back-compat fallback, W61 atomic drop of the legacy fields + CLI flags) so the call graph stayed green through each stage. Post-W61 every consumer reads problem / desired_outcome directly; legacy fields have no remaining producer and would only invite re-introduction drift.
D28.title: IntentBrief field set ratified per W24 audit

alternatives: Reactive wave inserting literal claim step 0 (rejected: duplicates executor system prompt; golden re-pair would also hit snapshot gate).
D29.rationale: Audit A42 follow-up flagged W57 success_criteria text 'SubagentSpec._render_workflow prepends step 0=eawf wave claim' as unmet. Operator 2026-05-28 AUQ confirmed the criterion was a labeling reference to the commit-prefix step (W57 renumbered it as step 4 of the 5-step body), not a literal directive. Subagent dispatch already wires claim via executor system prompt outside _render_workflow; a literal step 0 would duplicate. W57 criterion closed as honored.
D29.title: W57 criterion step-0 ratified as labeling reference

alternatives: Global enforce flip rejected as too broad for a contained PoC
Sibling rubric file rejected as a second schema to keep in sync
Jury certifying the jury rejected as meta-circular
D30.rationale: UI/UX behaviour cannot be fully pinned by deterministic tests so a markdown-spec LLM-jury scores the residual. The gameability red-team proved naive jury gates are gameable via provenance-free evidence and deterministic-decidable rubric items; so deterministic gates rank first, the jury judges only the true residual on provenance-pinned evidence, and discrimination is proven by a deterministic canned-ballot gate not a jury. Producer and jury un-idle for the UI/UX band only via a scoped verify block not the global enforce flip.
D30.title: I08 QC gate is deterministic-first with a jury for the true residual
